description: Injects Schema.org Product JSON-LD structured data (price, ZAR currency, SKU, brand, availability) on product pages for Google Search.
label: Enable Google Product Rich Snippets (JSON-LD SEO)
name: Webshop Settings-enable_google_jsonld

description: Select the target industry so this product appears under Shop by Industry filters.
label: Industry
name: Website Item-industry
options:
Mining & Construction
Corporate & Finance
Hospitality & Events
Healthcare & Medical
Education & Universities
Sports, Golf Days & Clubs
Retail, FMCG & Activations
Government & NGOs

description: Allow unregistered guests to add items to cart and checkout/request quotes without logging in.
label: Enable Guest Checkout
name: Webshop Settings-enable_guest_checkout

description: Allow customers to select Cash on Delivery (COD) at checkout in addition to online payment.
label: Enable Cash on Delivery
name: Webshop Settings-enable_cod

description: Delivery / COD handling fee added to Cash on Delivery orders (ex VAT).
label: Cash on Delivery Fee (ex VAT)
name: Webshop Settings-cod_delivery_charge

description: Waive COD delivery fee when order subtotal (ex VAT) reaches this amount. Set 0 to always charge.
label: Free COD Delivery Over (ex VAT)
name: Webshop Settings-cod_free_delivery_over

description: Rate per chargeable kg (ex VAT) added to the base courier fee when shipment exceeds 50 kg actual or volumetric weight.
label: Road Freight Rate per kg (ex VAT)
name: Webshop Settings-road_freight_rate_per_kg

description: Standard SA road courier divisor is 4000 (L × W × H ÷ 4000). Air/express couriers typically use 5000.
label: Volumetric Weight Divisor
name: Webshop Settings-volumetric_weight_divisor

description: Automatically generate a Material Request when an online Sales Order is submitted.
label: Auto-Create Material Request on Online Order
name: Webshop Settings-auto_create_material_request

label: Default Material Request Type
name: Webshop Settings-auto_mr_type
options:
Purchase
Material Transfer
Material Issue
Manufacture

description: If checked, only creates Material Request lines for the shortfall quantity not currently available in the warehouse.
label: Only Request Items Short of Available Stock
name: Webshop Settings-auto_mr_only_shortage

description: Automatically create and publish a Website Item whenever a new enabled Sales Item is created or imported.
label: Auto-Publish New Sales Items to Website
name: Webshop Settings-auto_publish_new_items

default: YEAR-END CORPORATE GIFTING PROMO: Get 15% OFF bulk orders + FREE Digital Mockups!
label: Promotion Banner Text
name: Webshop Settings-promo_banner_text

description: Optional: Enter GTM container ID (e.g. GTM-XXXXXXX) to manage all tags via Tag Manager.
label: Google Tag Manager ID (GTM-XXXX)
name: Webshop Settings-google_gtm_id

description: Enables GA4 page views and e-commerce purchase/begin_checkout tracking.
label: Google Analytics 4 Measurement ID (G-XXXX)
name: Webshop Settings-google_ga4_id

description: Format: AW-123456789/AbCdEfGhIjK (fires conversion event on completed checkout).
label: Google Ads Conversion ID / Label
name: Webshop Settings-google_ads_conversion_id

description: Enter your 15–16 digit Meta Pixel ID to track PageView, InitiateCheckout, and Purchase events on Facebook & Instagram.
label: Meta (Facebook / Instagram) Pixel ID
name: Webshop Settings-meta_pixel_id

label: Enable Google Merchant Center XML Feed (/api/method/promo_theme.api.google_merchant_feed)
name: Webshop Settings-enable_google_merchant_feed
